text:
Alex: Heads-up — I pushed a change to the internal routing header in staging (x-rdwd-policy -> x-rdwd-ingress). Go client canary is failing CI with 400s. Anyone available to triage?
Priya: Saw the failures this morning. Minimal repro: server returns 400 when x-rdwd-ingress is missing. Go client only emits the old header.
Sam: Could we make the server accept both headers temporarily to avoid a client cutover outage?
Jordan: We originally wanted strictness for safety, but +1 for a short-lived compatibility window. Suggest accept-legacy for ~2 weeks and monitor.
Alex: Repro/logs: ```ERROR: missing header x-rdwd-ingress
trace: router.go:142 handleRequest``` Python/TS clients already send both headers; only go is affected because of a low-level http wrapper. I can add a quick shim in go-client to set the new header when only legacy present.
Priya: :thumbsup: If we do a client shim, add an e2e that covers the legacy header path and emit a telemetry event so Console can track fallback rate.
Jordan: Console/Platform: we should add a rollout tile showing legacy header fallback counts + any quota attribution oddities.
Taylor: On it. Which metric name do you want? I can add route.header_fallback.count or route.legacy_header_fallback. Prefer the former for consistency.
Sam: Platform: if server accepts both, ensure quota/ledger only attributes once. Can we canonicalize header name to one route id before quota calc?
Alex: Yes — I'll add a canonicalization step in the router before quota evaluation and include unit tests.
Priya: Plan: Alex PR with go shim + server canonicalization + tests; Taylor dashboard tile; Jordan config flag and deprecation note. Timeline: ship canary patch today, monitor 24h, remove legacy acceptance in 2 weeks.
Sam: Add a feature flag ingress.legacy_header_accept=true for canary default.
deploy-bot: deploy started: r-server/staging v2024.9.5
Alex: Deployed canary and pushed the go-client shim branch. Tagging thread — @Taylor please ping when your tile is up.
Taylor: Tile up: https://console.internal/d/abc123/header-fallback — added sampling so we don't flood metrics.
Priya: Monitoring — if we see regressions or unexpected quota shifts, escalate to #eng-oncall. :eyes:
Jordan: I'll write a short RFC for the 2-week deprecation timeline and coordinate release notes.
